judged_text: PollFeed calls CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) on feed items whose entry has no content element (standard RSS 2.0 uses description, not content), raising NoMethodError on nil and aborting the whole poll run. Any feed where an item lacks <content> makes SimpleRSS return nil for i.content; the job raises NoMethodError, and since sidekiq_options retry: false is set, the run silently dies before processing remaining items, so no topics are imported until the feed changes.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, PollFeed#poll_feed does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item lacks `content` (i.content is nil), this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub`, aborting the job. The diff also sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single nil content item would prevent processing remaining items with no automatic retry.
